product.en: Grok Bot is the always-on AI teammate launched 2026-08-11 by xAI/SpaceXAI with Cursor. Each Bot shares one persistent cloud computer (browser, files, terminal) and keeps working after you close the laptop. It is not grok.com chat, Grok Imagine, or a Grok 4.x model writeup.
product.zh: Grok Bot 是 2026-08-11 由 xAI/SpaceXAI 与 Cursor 上线的 always-on 云电脑队友。每个 Bot 共享一台持久云电脑（浏览器、文件、终端），合上笔记本也不停。它不是 grok.com 聊天、Grok Imagine，也不是 Grok 4.x 模型评测。

blurb.en: Launch note: always-on agents with their own computer, working inside your tools 24/7.
blurb.zh: 首发稿：always-on 智能体自带电脑，在你的工具里 24/7 干活。

blurb.en: Canonical product page: one named Bot, one shared cloud computer, isolation is per user not per Bot.
blurb.zh: 产品总览：有名字的 Bot、共享一台云电脑；隔离按账号不按 Bot。

blurb.en: Install desktop, sign in with Cursor, create the first Bot. No official Linux desktop.
blurb.zh: 装桌面端、用 Cursor 登录、建第一个 Bot。官方无 Linux 桌面。

blurb.en: Official roster ideas: sales CRM nights, ops invoices, engineering bug squash.
blurb.zh: 官方编制示例：销售夜间更 CRM、运营发票入职、工程复现 Bug。

blurb.en: Companion phone app for messaging Bots that keep running on the cloud machine.
blurb.zh: iOS 同伴 App：在手机上给仍在云电脑上干活的 Bot 发消息。

blurb.en: How a Bot is named, scoped, and kept as a standing coworker instead of a chat thread.

blurb.en: Bots message each other, join group chats, and assign ownership of work.
blurb.zh: Bot 互发消息、进群聊、互相派活和认领。

blurb.en: Where artifacts live on the shared computer and how you pull results back.
blurb.zh: 产物落在共享电脑哪里，以及怎么把结果拿回来。

blurb.en: Browser, filesystem, terminal. No clean API? Click the site like a person.
blurb.zh: 浏览器、文件系统、终端。没有干净 API 就用云浏览器点。

blurb.en: Teach a task (up to 10 minutes of screen, no mic), save as a reusable routine.
blurb.zh: Teach a task（最多录 10 分钟屏幕、不录麦），存成可复用 routine。

blurb.en: Notification grouping, mobile alerts, and how Bots follow up stalled work.
blurb.zh: 通知按 Bot 分组、手机提醒，以及 Bot 怎么跟未完成的活。

blurb.en: Bots do not see passwords; draw the approval line on irreversible actions and 2FA takeover.
blurb.zh: Bot 看不见密码；审批线画在不可逆动作和 2FA Take over 上。

blurb.en: Team marketplace, SSO, shared analytics. Plugins follow existing Cursor policy.
blurb.zh: 团队市场、SSO、共享用量。插件策略跟现有 Cursor 政策走。

blurb.en: Official fix list for reconnect, runners, and common beta failures.
blurb.zh: 官方排障：重连、runner 挂掉、常见 beta 故障。

blurb.en: Short official answers on access, computer sharing, and what Bots can remember.
blurb.zh: 官方短答：资格、共享电脑、Bot 记得什么。

blurb.en: Cursor help: Heavy / Ultra / Teams Premium gates, and Ultra does not stack twice.
blurb.zh: Cursor 帮助：Heavy / Ultra / Teams Premium 门槛；已在 Ultra 再绑不叠用量。

blurb.en: How the iOS companion talks to Bots that stay on the cloud computer.
blurb.zh: iOS 同伴怎么跟仍在云电脑上的 Bot 说话。

blurb.en: Prefer a plugin; fall back to the cloud browser when the connector is missing.
blurb.zh: 优先插件；没有连接器就退回云浏览器。

blurb.en: Use the secret card. Never paste API keys into the Bot chat.
blurb.zh: 密钥走 secret card，禁止把 Key 贴进聊天。
